paper_title: Axion and neutrino bounds improved with new calibrations of the tip of the red-giant branch using geometric distance determinations
notes: Astrophysical (stellar evolution) bound from tip of the red-giant branch (TRGB) calibrations with new geometric distances. Paper reports g_ae < 1.6e-13 (95% CL) from NGC 4258 (cleanest extragalactic) and g_ae < 1.3e-13 (95% CL) from omega Centauri (best galactic target); the most restrictive value 1.3e-13 is emitted. Bound is mass-independent for axion masses well below the RGB core temperature; paper states no explicit validity range, so mass=0 sentinel used. Also constrains neutrino magnetic dipole moment mu_nu < 1.2e-12 mu_B (not in coupling enum). Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption. Table I provides per-calibration limits: NGC 4258 g13<1.58, LMC(F20) 1.58, LMC(Y19) 1.25, omega Cen 1.29 (95% CL). | selector: text (sole candidate)
